| # Safety communication via CAN {#safety-communication-via-can-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                                        |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The CAN communication provided by the RC conforms to CAN 2.0 as specified in ISO 11898-1, with all the required safety measures implemented in the data link layer. As a result, the worst case residual error probability for a channel is R(PCAN) = 7­ • 10-9 ≈ 1• 10-8

Except for the CANopen Safety library and J1939-76 communication over J1939, there is no additional safety communication layer provided with the RCs. To use the CAN interface for safety-related communications, it is machine manufacturer's responsibility that the safety communication layer is implemented as required by the corresponding standards.

For the conformity with ISO 25119, depending on the required DC, diagnostic methods could be implemented by the ASW following Table C.6 of the ISO 25119-2.

  Technique/ measure   Recommended maximum diagnostic coverage   Example
  -------------------- ----------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------
  Message protection   Medium                                    1\. Checksum on selected message data bytes
                       Medium                                    2\. Message enumeration (incrementing counter)
                       Low                                       3\. Send frequency verification
                       High                                      1 to 3. combined

For the conformity with ISO 13849-1, all relevant requirements of IEC 61784-3 shall be fulfilled by the communication channel.

With the additional CANopen Safety package, a safety communication layer according to CiA 304 is provided. All relevant requirements of ISO 25119 and ISO 13849 regarding safety-related data communication are fulfilled and DC = high can be reached.

With the J1939-76 communication stack, a safety extension to J1939 according to J1939-76 standard is provided. All relevant requirements of ISO 25119 and IEC 61784 regarding safety-critical data communication are fulfilled and DC = high can be achieved. The communication error coverage details are provided in the section [\'Communication Error Coverage\'](j1939-76-protocol-description.html){.topiclink}.
